title: Linear Variance of the Random 3-SAT Hitting Time
main_claim: For random 3-SAT with i.i.d. uniform proper 3-clauses (with replacement), the hitting time H_n of unsatisfiability satisfies Var(H_n)=Theta(n): upper bound O(n) proved in full via a new potential P_d(S)=sum_{j<d} q_j(S); lower bound from Wilson's sqrt(n) separation theorem.

issues.description: The lower bound depends on Wilson's Corollary 4 holding for the exact model used here (independent uniformly signed proper clauses sampled with replacement) and in the stated survival-function form. The paper asserts this without checking the model match.
issues.evidence: The theorem is quoted as 'a consequence of Wilson's theorem for the independent proper-clause model with replacement'; no translation between models is given. The deduction from it (a_n, b_n, the independent-copy argument giving Var >= (b_n-a_n)^2/16) checks out.

coverage: Checked every step of the upper bound. Lemma 2.1: h_a=(b)_a/(2^a(u)_a), sqrt(h2)<=b/(2u), h3/h2>=b/(6u) for b>=3, and the b=2 error term. Lemma 2.2: the increment identities, Jensen, and the power-mean telescoping. Lemma 3.1: coordinate-omission Efron-Stein. The exposure and the independence of ordinary and test parts given E. G_m/H_m measurability. Root-flip test lemma: the availability and collision case analysis and the independence across roots. Occupation lemma: K=7 from 3+80/n^2+1, with at most Z non-ordinary steps. Duration corollary. Tower step in Prop 4.3 (exponents 3-beta=beta, d^{2beta}=d^3; V=1 case p^{1/2}<=1). Incidence moments: p_hit<=9/n, p_coll=18/(n(n-1)), E e^Z bound, Binomial(V,2) bound. Cap removal: tail-sum formula, (1+r)/(1-r)^2=120, 2(7/8)^10<1. Lower-bound deduction and the window corollary. Wilson's theorem itself was taken on citation.
sibling_notes: Consistent with the family-235 board entries. It reproves the companion paper's (Variance of Random k-SAT Hitting Time) omission/root-test framework rather than citing it, so there is no circularity. The only shared external input is Wilson Cor. 4, which the rank-311 sibling also flagged as taken on citation.
